comment.body:
The report gives a useful repeatable symptom. Please provide:

1. A fresh diagnostic archive by commenting `/bugreport` immediately after the next desynchronization and attaching the ZIP unchanged.
2. Whether the peer still appears connected in Mouse Without Borders.
3. Whether the two PCs can still ping each other.

This will distinguish a lost TCP session, missed heartbeat, reconnect failure, and stale peer state.
